mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.book_id, b.title AS book_title, m.chapter_index, m.paragraph_index, c.title AS chapter_title, m.note, m.published, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM bookmarks m JOIN books b ON b.id = m.book_id JOIN chapters c ON c.book_id = m.book_id AND c.chapter_index = m.chapter_index
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmarks (id, book_id, chapter_index, paragraph_index, note, published, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookId}, #{chapterIndex}, #{paragraphIndex}, #{note}, #{published}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bookmarks SET note = #{note}, published = #{published}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
